$comment: School crests (one per academy school) and stand-in crests by mana colour for campaign chapters and gauntlet runs. Replaces the drawn Crest in ModeArt.tsx.
style: School and colour crests: one heater-shaped shield per cell, front view, perfectly symmetrical, every shield the same outline and size. The shield's field is ONE flat solid area of the accent ink named by the subject, with a thick ivory rim, and one bold ivory emblem printed over the field. Each shield fills about 85% of its cell's height.
spare: a plain shield, accent ink none
